interpretation.sensitivity: One factor at a time. Exploration values, not manufacturer uncertainty bounds or confidence intervals. No joint-factor envelope claim.
interpretation.pump: Scale shutoff head ONLY with fixed curve K and fixed network. Merely varying fitted shutoff factor at the same design point algebraically cancels and is an invariance check, not pump uncertainty coverage.
interpretation.faults: Injected physical/sensor effects never enter controller or M1 views. Slow response may or may not confirm under frozen rules; report observed outcome, never force confirmation.
interpretation.recovery: End of physical fault does not reset Safety FAULT. No operator reset is authorized in these cases.
interpretation.return45: V1 max secondary rack-return control reference45degC is an engineering assumption; customer45degC is RACK_SECONDARY_INLET protection. Customer return45 requirement NOT_REGISTERED. No 45degC return acceptance scoring.
